ops.oldText: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates, including migration support and export of Customer Data. Vendor shall not delete or render inaccessible any Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.

input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept immediate cessation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export, which is a walk-away position for us and also contradicts Sections 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced it with our standard exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, with deletion occurring only under the Section 11.2/11.3 return-and-certification mechanics (we can discuss a 90-day assistance period if six months is difficult).
input.summary: Replace immediate-deletion/no-assistance clause with 6-month transition assistance and preserve the 11.2/11.3 data-return and certified-deletion sequence.
